description:
Connect your Continuum organization to find meetings, retrieve meeting details and available transcripts, and look up contacts, households and tasks. Prepare for conversations and review follow-ups using records you can access in Continuum.

Create tasks, draft client pages, inspect page activity, and publish pages after reviewing them in Continuum. Publishing makes the recipient link available subject to its access settings; it does not send the link.

Requires a Continuum account and organization access. Available capabilities depend on your account.
